evals.name: over-athletic-overdose
evals.prompt: Have a look at this passage from my book and tell me what's working and what's not — does it actually land? The file is C:/Claude/agent-os-v3/agentic-os/.claude/skills/writ-review/evals/inputs/00_over-athletic.md
evals.expected_output: Flags athletic / three-word writing as OVERUSED (an overdose) and a voice-conflict; prescribes restoring flow and reserving short sentences for 1-2 peaks. Must NOT praise the staccato or recommend adding more short punchy lines.

assertions.text: Flags athletic / three-word writing as overused or an overdose, not a strength
Prescribes restoring flowing sentences and reserving short lines for 1-2 emotional peaks
Does NOT recommend adding more short / punchy / athletic sentences

evals.name: journalism-opener
evals.prompt: Review the opening of my book. Is this a strong opening, and how would you sharpen it? The file is C:/Claude/agent-os-v3/agentic-os/.claude/skills/writ-review/evals/inputs/01_journalism-opener.md
evals.expected_output: Identifies the opening as journalism (who/what/where/when), failing the story-not-journalism posture; prescribes leading with the consequence and emotional (non-chronological) sequencing.

assertions.text: Identifies the opening as journalism (who/what/where/when) failing the story-not-journalism posture
Prescribes leading with the consequence and/or emotional (non-chronological) sequencing
Treats the flat chronology as the core problem rather than merely praising its clarity

evals.name: working-piece-restraint
evals.prompt: Score this book opening for me — is it working, and what would you change? The file is C:/Claude/agent-os-v3/agentic-os/.claude/skills/writ-review/evals/inputs/02_working-piece.md
evals.expected_output: Recognises the piece is largely working (high score / pass or near-pass); names specific strengths; does NOT manufacture faults or tell the writer to add more devices.

assertions.text: Recognises the piece is largely working (high score, pass or near-pass)
Names specific working elements (focus story / diamond, consequence-led, call-to-mirror, flowing voice)
Does NOT manufacture faults or recommend cramming in more devices

evals.name: flat-corporate-underdose
evals.prompt: Can you review this bit of website copy and help me make it really work? The file is C:/Claude/agent-os-v3/agentic-os/.claude/skills/writ-review/evals/inputs/03_flat-corporate.md
evals.expected_output: Flags it as describe/persuade marketing-speak failing the postures; prescribes ADDING fire / a statement question / a consequence-led lead and replacing the generic CTA with a call-to-mirror. Correctly treats under-use as the defect.

assertions.text: Flags it as describe/persuade marketing-speak failing the postures (no story, no understanding/mirror)
Prescribes ADDING the right devices (fire, statement question, consequence lead) and a call-to-mirror instead of the generic CTA
Correctly treats under-use as the defect here (recommends adding), not over-use

evals.name: real-toyb-chapter-1
evals.prompt: Review chapter 1 of my book 'Thinking Outside Your Brain' against the Dennis Ross 'Lead With Words' methodology — what's working, what's not, and what gets it to a 9? The file is C:/Claude/agent-os-v3/agentic-os/.claude/skills/writ-review/evals/inputs/04_toyb-ch01.md
evals.expected_output: A complete Map + posture + device scores against Dennis Ross with line/section evidence; a coherent verdict against the 9/10 book gate with the top 1-3 highest-leverage fixes; located, specific prescriptions.

assertions.text: Produces a complete Map plus posture and device scores against Dennis Ross with line/section evidence
Gives a coherent verdict against the 9/10 book gate with the top 1-3 highest-leverage fixes
Prescriptions are located and specific (named sections/lines), not generic advice
